end.summary:
Defined and classified examples of physical and chemical changes.
Correctly classified ice melting/freezing, burning paper, roasted chapati, curd formation, and melting ghee.
Used reversibility, colour, smell, and formation of a new substance as evidence.
Physical-change definition was not yet stated independently in the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical and chemical changes using examples such as ice, paper, chapati, curd, and ghee. They used evidence such as reversibility, colour, smell, and whether a new substance formed; a mix-up about chai being only mixing/heating was resolved by identifying its colour and smell changes and that it cannot return to milk. At home, ask Ananya to explain one physical change and one chemical change, including whether a new substance forms.
